title: 2024 AMC 12A Problem 15
statement: The roots of \(x^3+2x^2-x+3\) are \(p\), \(q\), and \(r\). What is the value of \[ (p^2+4)(q^2+4)(r^2+4)? \]

solutions.text: Since \(P(x)=(x-p)(x-q)(x-r),\) grouping \(p^2+4=(p-2i)(p+2i)\) over all roots gives \[ \prod(p^2+4)=P(2i)\,P(-2i). \] Compute \(P(2i)=-8i-8-2i+3\) \(=-5-10i\) and \(P(-2i)=8i-8+2i+3\) \(=-5+10i.\) Their product is \((-5)^2+10^2=25+100=125.\) Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: \(p^2+4=(p-2i)(p+2i),\) so the product relates to \(P(2i)\) and \(P(-2i),\) where \(P(x)=x^3+2x^2-x+3\)
\(P(2i)\) and \(P(-2i)\) are complex conjugates; multiply them to get a real number
